headers.//: Static assets were served `max-age=0, must-revalidate`, so every return visit blocked on ~27 conditional requests before anything ran. `stale-while-revalidate` lets the browser paint from cache immediately and check for a new copy in the background. The trade is that one load after a deploy may use the previous file; the visit after it is current. Nothing here is content-hashed, so a longer max-age is not safe.
The entry point always revalidates: it is small over the wire and it is what names every other file.
